exposure: cesarean delivery for non-reassuring fetal status (NRFS)
outcome: Cesarean delivery for non-reassuring fetal status (NRFS)
finding: Newborns with the highest probability of adverse perinatal outcomes are those who are small-for-gestational-age without fetal growth detention.
mod_finding: AGA newborns with FGD do not have a higher incidence of APOs than AGA newborns without FGD, although with falls in percentile cutoff over 40, they have an increased risk of cesarean section due to NRFS.
